scope: Cast1 aquarium benchmark launches through J-8c4c0f882e93. A launch is a verified install of a case; a loss is a case that produced no measurement. Derived from receipts, apk-installations.json, commands.json and the coordinator's process-exit-info.txt; raw logcat stays local.

close-idle-pair1-gpu.note: Also launched without loss by J-49a2f4008d65 (check), J-084b4f52095d and held J-0d2afeba096d.

close-idle-none-gpu.note: Lost to Back reaching the system, not a process death; see incidents.

incidents.exit: ApplicationExitInfo pid=30834 at 18:37:43.828: reason=2 (SIGNALED) status=11 (SIGSEGV), pss=0
incidents.finding: A native SIGSEGV about 1.6 s after the panel Back and about 8 s after launch. Recorded by Android exit-info, captured later by J-8c4c0f882e93; the earlier empty crash buffer did not rule a crash out.

incidents.exit: Process still present at 16:01:26.5 and 16:01:42.3; foreground later lost to the launcher during the case
incidents.finding: Not a death at Back. Cause of the foreground loss unknown. The preceding none-case process logged two DPAD_CENTER presses at 16:01:00.7 and 16:01:06.5 that no benchmark command sent.

incidents.exit: No exit record for pid 32381; observation panel-back-system-back
incidents.finding: Capture showed the panel (white 0.638, black 0.353, fill 1.0) yet the engine handled the single Back as a system Back (key code=4 action=1 mask=...), so it did not consider the panel visible. A KEYCODE_WAKEUP from the coordinator's session-wake ran concurrently (22:51:01.730). Why PanelVisible() was false is unproven: the process logcat was parsed by the coordinator and not saved.

summary: Five pair1 launches have died with the identical NULL mailbox-lookup SIGSEGV on actor 30: three close-idle GPU (3/7) and two wide-idle CPU from the pre-experiment baseline. GPU skinning is not the cause. The other 44 launches in this campaign had no startup death. J-8c4c0f882e93 is a separate Back mis-delivery, not a crash.

crash_signature.source: The engine's own crash handler lines in the cumulative device wf.log, recovered from later sessions' 4 MB tails (held-close-idle-gpu-round-3-J-0d2afeba096d/wf.log, local only).
crash_signature.symbolized_by: Byte-pattern match into the unstripped worktree builds (build ids 00130532 and 890d8bdf), then addr2line
crash_signature.fault: WorldFoundryMailboxesManager::LookupMailboxes(int), wfsource/source/game/level.cc:340: _objects[objectIndex] is NULL in a release build (assert compiled out)
crash_signature.actor_index: 30 (r1=0x1e; r8=0x41f00000 is 30.0f, the Forth cell): the pair-0 male seahorse body, ticked as "30 31 1 1 sh-tick" and written by sh-place

occurrences.variant: wide-idle pair1 (seahorse CPU baseline, no skinning code)
wide-idle pair1 CPU profile (baseline, no skinning code)
occurrences.build: pre-experiment, pc +0x150bd6, same registers; crashed after a full 95-frame profile window with level-objects 81

crash_signature.conclusion: Not a GPU-skinning defect. A pre-existing pair1 seahorse fault: the male body actor 30 leaves the level object list while its script keeps writing its mailboxes. The deaths come 6-8 s after launch, close to its scripted first rest of 6 s (sh-first-rest 1) and release. Why actor 30 is removed (the engine removes actors that leave every room, die, or set ALIVE 0) is not proven.

reproduction.attempt: Container ASan/UBSan Debug build (asserts on) of the worktree; frozen close-idle-pair1-gpu cd.iff and wf_args.txt; 1 x 45 s and 3 x 120 s under Xvfb/llvmpipe
reproduction.result: No crash, assert or sanitizer report. The build runs at about 2 fps, so every frame hits the engine 0.2 s delta clamp (device frames are about 0.05 s); about 32 game seconds per run. Not reproduced.

reruns.classification: Not the known crash and not a measurement. The first install (pair2, 25525fcc) and the restore install (3d796c77) were refused with INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE: cast1 already had aquarium versionCode 41 installed (sha 1008aed8...), and the frozen APKs are versionCode 7. Cleanup could not be verified; the coordinator's automatic readd J-ff796a60b072 ended recovery-required, and cast1 needs an administrator readd. The v41 package came from outside this campaign.
